ndee7514fd4.headline: Service industry growth slows as firms hit by ‘sluggish’ demand
ndee7514fd4.summary: UK service sector growth slowed as firms reported sluggish demand. The latest reading was stronger than economists had expected, when a figure of 51.2 had been forecast.
ndee7514fd4.why: The UK services sector makes up most of the economy, so its activity levels are closely watched as a gauge of growth and of Bank of England policy.

n59a180010a.headline: Brazil’s Job Engine Roars: Over 1.2 Million Formal New Hires Reflect Shifting Strength
n59a180010a.summary: Brazil's Ministry of Labor and Employment confirmed the country created 1,222,591 new formal jobs in the first half of 2025, according to the report.
n59a180010a.why: Formal employment levels shape consumer spending, tax receipts, and the labour market that central bank policy responds to in Brazil.

n02f35d7975.headline: Czechia deploys 357 MW of solar in H1
n02f35d7975.summary: Czechia's solar installations in the first half of 2025 were down on the same period in 2024. Cumulative capacity reached 4,825 MW at the end of June 2025.
n02f35d7975.why: Solar deployment affects power supply, electricity prices, and investment in the renewable energy sector across Central Europe.

n6dc4602ed5.headline: Nigerian marketer MRS yet to reduce fuel price, gives reason
n6dc4602ed5.summary: MRS filling stations have not reduced their premium motor spirit price, according to a Daily Post Nigeria report. The report says the marketer gave a reason for the delay.
n6dc4602ed5.why: Petrol pump prices in Nigeria are set by marketers and follow import costs and the naira exchange rate, which shape inflation and consumer spending.

nc1d2ce4cb8.headline: NSDL, Sri Lotus, M&B Engeering IPO: GMP rises before market listings; solid debuts ahead? - BusinessToday
nc1d2ce4cb8.summary: Three companies, NSDL, Sri Lotus Developers and M&B Engineering, are set to debut on Indian markets on Wednesday, August 6. Grey market premiums are rising ahead of the listings.
nc1d2ce4cb8.why: Initial public offerings bring new companies to the stock exchange and are watched as a gauge of investor appetite for new listings.

n97f2abc0bd.headline: Brazil's Housing Prices Jump as Monthly Growth Hits 0.58% in July, Outpacing Inflation
n97f2abc0bd.summary: FipeZAP data show Brazilian residential prices rose 0.58% in July and 7.97% over the year, against 5.3% inflation. The average price is R$9,375 per square metre.
n97f2abc0bd.why: Housing prices affect household wealth, mortgage demand and construction activity, and they are tracked as a signal of inflation pressure.

n6b15027798.headline: BP increases staff cuts to 6,200 and signals further possible reductions
n6b15027798.summary: BP said it is now cutting more than the 4,700 roles and 3,000 contractor positions announced at the start of the year. It did not rule out further reductions.
n6b15027798.why: BP is a major integrated oil company, and workforce reductions are part of its cost-cutting and restructuring efforts.

nc46a116ece.headline: Gold Fields expects bumper profit as gold price, volumes surge
nc46a116ece.summary: Gold Fields said its half-year profit is expected to rise by as much as 236% on higher gold production and record bullion prices. The company is South African.
nc46a116ece.why: Gold Fields is a major gold miner, so its earnings closely track gold prices and production volumes.

n4c46764996.headline: CBK Launches First Household Remittance Survey to determine amount of Dollars Kenyans receive from Abroad - Ghetto Radio
n4c46764996.summary: The Central Bank of Kenya has launched its first household remittance survey, running July to September 2025, to measure dollar inflows from abroad.
n4c46764996.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign exchange for Kenya, supporting the shilling and household incomes.

n4bfed5fb49.headline: Brazil’s Financial Morning Call for August 5, 2025
n4bfed5fb49.summary: Brazil's financial markets opened under the weight of global trade uncertainties and domestic fiscal pressures, according to the morning briefing.
n4bfed5fb49.why: Ibovespa is the main benchmark of the B3 exchange in São Paulo, and Brazil's fiscal path influences local interest rates and the real.

ne9ae05b420.headline: StoneX Completes Acquisition of The Benchmark Company to Expand Investment Banking Capabilities
ne9ae05b420.summary: StoneX has completed its acquisition of The Benchmark Company, a move the company says expands its investment banking capabilities.
ne9ae05b420.why: StoneX is a financial services firm offering brokerage and market access, and acquisitions like this add advisory and capital-markets capacity.

n90a609b618.headline: Three-month ROBOR index fell to 6.60% per annum on Tuesday
n90a609b618.summary: The three-month ROBOR index, used to price variable-rate lei consumer loans, fell to 6.60% per year from 6.61% in the previous session, according to the National Bank of Romania.
n90a609b618.why: ROBOR is Romania's benchmark interbank rate, and it sets borrowing costs for variable-rate loans in lei.

n672a281740.headline: Thinking big: Plans to boost Northland with a special economic zone
n672a281740.summary: New Zealand minister Shane Jones says tax incentives and self-consenting could boost Northland through a special economic zone. The plan is presented as a way to fire up the region.
n672a281740.why: Special economic zones use tax and planning incentives to attract investment, which can affect regional development and construction activity.

n7e23fc5c5f.headline: Yet another record high as KSE-100 soars past 143,000 points
n7e23fc5c5f.summary: Pakistan's benchmark KSE-100 index closed at 143,037.17, up 984.52 points. The close was reported as another record high.
n7e23fc5c5f.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's main stock benchmark, tracking the largest companies listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
n7e23fc5c5f.why_moved: The index closed at a record high after gaining 984.52 points, according to the input; no specific driver is given.

n0ac979edb5.headline: Service industry growth slows as firms hit by ‘sluggish’ demand
n0ac979edb5.summary: UK services sector growth slowed as firms were hit by sluggish demand. The latest reading was stronger than the 51.2 economists had predicted.
n0ac979edb5.why: Services make up most of the UK economy, so the services PMI is a key gauge of economic momentum and inflation pressure.

n8caa1a0b12.headline: Weak Insurance Premiums Hit BB Seguridade; Pague Menos Faces Debt, Copasa Struggles With Costs
n8caa1a0b12.summary: Recent results show weak insurance premiums at BB Seguridade, debt pressure at Pague Menos and cost struggles at Copasa, despite big profits at some major names.
n8caa1a0b12.why: BB Seguridade, Pague Menos and Copasa are Brazilian listed companies in insurance, pharmacy retail and water utilities, respectively.

n1685114a9a.headline: Aramco Profit Falls for 10th Straight Quarter
n1685114a9a.summary: Saudi Aramco reported a decline in profit for a 10th consecutive quarter. Lower oil prices outweighed the benefit of higher production.
n1685114a9a.why: Saudi Aramco is the state-controlled oil giant and one of the world's largest oil producers, so its earnings signal the health of global crude markets.

n9fcf260afb.headline: Tata Capital IPO: DRHP updated; marketmen see price band 50% below unlisted market price! - BusinessToday
n9fcf260afb.summary: Tata Sons-backed Tata Capital filed an updated draft red herring prospectus with India's markets regulator Sebi for its IPO. Marketmen expect the price band to be 50% below the unlisted market price.
n9fcf260afb.why: Tata Capital is a non-banking lender within the Tata group, and large Indian IPOs shape liquidity and valuation sentiment in domestic capital markets.

nf288d06a7f.headline: A look at the top buyers of Russian oil as Trump pressures China and India to stop buying it - The Boston Globe
nf288d06a7f.summary: President Trump is pushing China and India to stop buying oil from Russia, which he says helps fund the Kremlin's war against Ukraine. The article examines the top buyers of Russian crude.
nf288d06a7f.why: Russia is one of the world's largest crude exporters, and changes in its buyers affect global oil flows, discounts and prices.
nf288d06a7f.why_moved: Pressure on China and India to stop buying Russian oil threatens a major source of crude demand for Russian exports and could tighten flows of discounted barrels.

nb2e9f89269.headline: Ukraine's Zelenskyy talks to Trump on sanctions, drone deal
nb2e9f89269.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he had a productive call with Donald Trump covering sanctions and a major drone deal. Russian attacks on Ukraine killed six people.
nb2e9f89269.why: Sanctions policy on Russia and defence supply deals affect energy markets, defence contractors and the broader outlook for the region's economy.

ncd821ec609.headline: State Ownership Versus Market Forces: What’s Next for Cemig, Copasa, and RD Saúde?
ncd821ec609.summary: Brazil's relationship with state-linked public companies, including Cemig, Copasa and RD Saúde, shows the trade-offs between state debt, market efficiency and government control.
ncd821ec609.why: Cemig and Copasa are Minas Gerais state-linked utilities, so decisions on their ownership and governance affect their valuation and investor returns.

ne58c19e707.headline: Dangote secures landmark US$4bn refinancing deal
ne58c19e707.summary: Nigeria's Dangote has secured a US$4bn refinancing deal, according to africanreview.com. The article is brief and gives no further detail on lenders or terms.
ne58c19e707.why: Dangote is a large privately held Nigerian conglomerate whose Lagos refinery is among the biggest in Africa, so its financing shapes investment in African energy.

ncc2d6e90e1.headline: Chilean Peso Holds Ground, Santiago Stocks Steady—Copper Policy Calms Markets While Top Shares Diverge
ncc2d6e90e1.summary: The Chilean peso held at 966.4 per US dollar and Santiago stocks were steady over the last 24 hours. Markets were calmed by a copper policy, while top shares diverged.
ncc2d6e90e1.why: Chile is the world's largest copper producer, so its currency and copper-related policy matter for global metals markets.

n87e7db33b0.headline: Brazil’s Prio and Brava Energia Push Oil Limits Amid Technical and Market Challenges
n87e7db33b0.summary: Brazilian independent oil producers Prio and Brava Energia shared impressive production results. The article also notes technical and market challenges facing the sector.
n87e7db33b0.why: Prio and Brava Energia are leading independent oil producers in Brazil's offshore and onshore fields, so their output affects national supply and investor sentiment in the sector.

n52beb33dea.headline: Tense Peso Gains and Select Stocks Lead Buenos Aires Markets Amid Volatility
n52beb33dea.summary: Argentina's financial markets showed volatility on August 5, 2025, with peso moves and stock swings, though trading volumes were robust. Official figures were also confirmed.
n52beb33dea.why: Buenos Aires markets, including the Merval index and the peso, reflect investor confidence in Argentina's economic policy.

n6c3f6bfb95.headline: National living wage likely to rise to £12.71 next year, advisory body estimates
n6c3f6bfb95.summary: The national living wage for workers aged 21 and over is currently £12.21 an hour. An advisory body estimates it will rise to £12.71 next year.
n6c3f6bfb95.why: The national living wage sets the minimum pay floor for older workers in the UK, shaping employer labour costs and inflation.

n314b58fb87.headline: Two of Canada’s most senior ministers head to Mexico to discuss trade
n314b58fb87.summary: Two of Canada's most senior cabinet ministers will hold bilateral meetings in Mexico City this week with officials and the Mexican president. Canada aims to strengthen trade ties outside the United States.
n314b58fb87.why: Canada and Mexico are major trading partners, and diversifying trade beyond the US affects export and investment flows.

n5b7ce39a94.headline: Kmart accused of misleading over slave labour supplies
n5b7ce39a94.summary: An Australian-based Uyghur group is taking Kmart to court, alleging the retailer sourced stock using forced labour while marketing its products. The case concerns Kmart's supply chain claims.
n5b7ce39a94.why: Kmart is an Australian discount retailer owned by Wesfarmers, and legal and reputational risks from supply-chain allegations can affect retail earnings.

nd895c8d3d5.headline: Central Bank should carry out ‘immediate’ review of Israeli war bonds – report
nd895c8d3d5.summary: A report says the Central Bank should carry out an immediate review of its holdings of Israeli war bonds. The item was reported by Kilkenny Live.
nd895c8d3d5.why: Central banks manage national reserves and their investment choices can draw scrutiny over ethical and reputational risk. Such reviews can affect reserve management policy.

nfba9a58eb1.headline: Welcome to Helbourne the happy
nfba9a58eb1.summary: Peak business bodies in NSW and South Australia say neighbouring states may benefit as businesses consider moving across the border after Premier Jacinta Allan's plan to enshrine a right to work from home.
nfba9a58eb1.why: Victoria is Australia's second-largest state economy, and business location decisions affect state tax bases, property demand and employment.

n345c00b584.headline: First home buyers squeezed by soaring prices
n345c00b584.summary: Higher-priced properties are typically the most volatile and sensitive to interest rate changes, according to MacroBusiness, with first home buyers squeezed by soaring prices.
n345c00b584.why: Housing costs and interest rate sensitivity influence household debt, bank mortgage books and the outlook for Australian consumer spending.

nfcb7bc9d99.headline: Buyback tax shift puts shareholders on notice: What has changed for investors - BusinessToday
nfcb7bc9d99.summary: The 2024 Union Budget moved the tax burden on share buybacks from companies to shareholders, with dividends possibly regaining favour as a return strategy.
nfcb7bc9d99.why: Tax treatment of buybacks versus dividends changes how companies return cash and how investors compare after-tax returns.

nc2379cbbdd.headline: Smelter rescue bolsters nation's critical metals future
nc2379cbbdd.summary: A bailout of two smelters has avoided catastrophe, according to a union. The union urges governments to take further action.
nc2379cbbdd.why: Smelters process critical metals and sit at the core of industrial supply chains. Government support decisions shape domestic production capacity for metals.

na0a02e7939.headline: Indian markets regulator aims for fewer related-party deals being reported, needing investor nod
na0a02e7939.summary: India's markets regulator proposed on Monday that low-value transactions between interconnected entities need not be reported. Such deals would instead need investor approval under the proposal.
na0a02e7939.why: The Securities and Exchange Board of India sets listing and disclosure rules for companies. Changes to related-party deal rules affect corporate governance and minority shareholder protection.

na8b77d4aca.headline: Explained: How Trump’s RAP rips up student debt rules; bigger bills, gutted aid, a brutal new reality for borrowers - Times of India
na8b77d4aca.summary: The Repayment Assistance Plan, enacted in July 2025, overhauls federal student loans starting July 2026. It replaces income-driven repayment, with reports of bigger bills and reduced aid for borrowers.
na8b77d4aca.why: Federal student loans are a large category of US household debt. Changes to repayment rules affect consumer spending, lenders and the federal budget.

n92b79d8e44.headline: Sensex drops 308 pts, Nifty settles below 24,650 as Trump tariff threat hurts sentiment - BusinessToday
n92b79d8e44.summary: The BSE Sensex closed down 308.47 points at 80,710.25. The NSE Nifty50 fell 73.20 points to settle at 24,649.55 as the tariff threat weighed on sentiment.
n92b79d8e44.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are India's benchmark stock indexes, tracking large listed companies. Their moves reflect domestic and global trade sentiment.

nd9c435f3c6.headline: Nigeria's July oil output tops 1.8 million bpd, regulator says
nd9c435f3c6.summary: Nigeria's oil production surpassed 1.8 million barrels per day last month, with current average output at 1.78 million bpd, the upstream regulator said. The statement was made on Monday.
nd9c435f3c6.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest crude producer, and its output levels influence global crude supply and the government's oil revenues.

n0bac5fbc44.headline: Cold weather and scant rains worry Ivory Coast cocoa farmers
n0bac5fbc44.summary: A persistent cold spell across Ivory Coast's cocoa regions could jeopardise the October-to-March main crop, farmers warned. Plantations need more sunshine and rain.
n0bac5fbc44.why: Ivory Coast is the world's largest cocoa producer, so its crop conditions influence global cocoa prices.

impacts.why: Weather threats to the main crop could tighten global cocoa supply.

n7b2d8aac58.headline: Senegal unveils recovery plan to rely on domestic funding
n7b2d8aac58.summary: Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko unveiled a new economic recovery plan for Senegal. The government pledged to finance 90% of the initiative through domestic resources and avoid additional debt.
n7b2d8aac58.why: Senegal's debt burden is a key concern for investors in its sovereign bonds and for the wider West African market.

n2e8844132a.headline: Housebuilder chaired by former Persimmon boss increases fire safety provision to more than £100m
n2e8844132a.summary: Avant, a housebuilder chaired by a former Persimmon boss, has raised its fire safety provision to more than £100m. The figure could change as buildings needing remediation are identified.
n2e8844132a.why: Avant Homes is a UK housebuilder, and fire safety provisions reflect remediation costs that can weigh on profits and balance sheets in the sector.

ncf6d664b29.headline: Lower Aussie inflation, but fewer rate cuts
ncf6d664b29.summary: The latest Q2 CPI print from the ABS came in benign, though the Westpac-Melbourne Institute gauge showed trimmed mean inflation remained low, leaving fewer rate cuts expected.
ncf6d664b29.why: Inflation data drives Reserve Bank of Australia rate decisions, which set borrowing costs across the Australian economy and the Australian dollar.

nca0b2cbcbf.headline: Industry says housing crisis is morphing into a construction crisis
nca0b2cbcbf.summary: New home approvals are accelerating under federal housing policy, but construction leaders warn that a shortage of tradespeople could prevent the homes from being built.
nca0b2cbcbf.why: Housing supply depends on construction capacity, and labour shortages affect building costs, timelines and housing policy outcomes.

ne201af2cbe.headline: Global recession no longer anticipated: HSBC
ne201af2cbe.summary: HSBC's global chief economist said a recession was not built into forecasts, as central banks manage tariff uncertainty and may cut interest rates again.
ne201af2cbe.why: HSBC is one of the world's largest banks, and its economic forecasts shape how investors view global growth and rate expectations.

n417a2c905f.headline: After unionized Canada Post workers reject 'final offers,' what happens next?
n417a2c905f.summary: About 55,000 members of the Canadian Union of Postal Workers rejected Canada Post's latest offers in a forced vote. Labour experts say another strike is unlikely while the parties weigh next steps.
n417a2c905f.why: Canada Post is the national postal operator, and labour disputes there affect mail and parcel delivery across Canada.

n9ef0192a2a.headline: Sally Textile says unaware in unusual price movement of shares
n9ef0192a2a.summary: Sally Textile Mills Limited said on Tuesday it was not aware of any development behind the recent unusual movement in its share price.
n9ef0192a2a.why: Textile manufacturers are exposed to export demand and input costs, and unexplained share moves prompt exchange disclosure checks for investors.

nb8795f5249.headline: After unionized Canada Post workers reject 'final offers,' what happens next?
nb8795f5249.summary: Unionised Canada Post workers rejected the employer's latest round of offers. Labour experts say another postal strike is unlikely, according to the report from Ottawa.
nb8795f5249.why: Canada Post is a federal Crown corporation, and labour disputes affect mail and parcel delivery and the company's operating costs.

nf2df11e103.headline: Eutelsat Grows LEO Revenue Grew by 80% in Fiscal Year With Government Demand
nf2df11e103.summary: Eutelsat's low Earth orbit revenue grew 84% year on year in its fiscal year, driven by increased services to Ukraine and other governments. The company is a satellite operator.
nf2df11e103.why: Eutelsat is a French satellite operator whose OneWeb low Earth orbit network serves governments and enterprises, and government demand is a key revenue driver.

nb9963f51ed.headline: Ireland needs to prepare for public spending rise as population ages – watchdog
nb9963f51ed.summary: An Irish watchdog says Ireland needs to prepare for a rise in public spending as its population ages. The warning was reported by Leitrim Live.
nb9963f51ed.why: Public spending trends, including pensions and health costs, shape government borrowing needs and fiscal policy.

n55615f96cf.headline: Elon Musk awarded $29bn in Tesla shares to steer shift to AI
n55615f96cf.summary: Tesla has awarded Elon Musk a share package worth $29 billion to keep him in charge as the company shifts focus from cars to robotaxis and humanoid robots.
n55615f96cf.why: Tesla is the largest electric vehicle maker by market value, and executive pay packages can affect governance, dilution and strategic direction.

impacts.why: The large share award to the CEO dilutes existing shareholders while signalling a pivot toward robotaxis and humanoid robots.

n930d2a2b27.headline: France’s PM turns to YouTube to sell his budget cuts
n930d2a2b27.summary: French Prime Minister François Bayrou is using the video platform YouTube to explain his austere budget cuts and win public support. The cuts are described as draconian.
n930d2a2b27.why: France's budget deficit and public spending decisions drive government bond yields and the euro-area fiscal outlook, so the budget plan matters for investors in French debt.

n5170ab0510.headline: Nissan begins talks with union to cut jobs at European regional office
n5170ab0510.summary: Nissan has started negotiations with a staff union over potential job cuts at its European regional office. The cuts are part of a restructuring aimed at reducing workforce and production capacity.
n5170ab0510.why: Nissan is a Japanese carmaker, and its restructuring plans affect cost, capacity and profitability as it adjusts to weaker demand and competition in global auto markets.

n5c547d10a0.headline: US trade deficit hits nearly 2-year low in June; China gap plunges
n5c547d10a0.summary: The US trade deficit narrowed in June on a sharp drop in consumer goods imports. The trade gap with China shrank to its lowest in more than 21 years.
n5c547d10a0.why: The trade balance feeds into GDP calculations and reflects the flow of goods between the US and its trading partners, which matters for currency and tariff policy.

n9e7e936e43.headline: Ambiq Micro Stock Pops on IPO Debut: What's Fueling the Surge?
n9e7e936e43.summary: Ambiq Micro's stock rose sharply on its IPO debut, with the company focusing on chips that offer the lowest power consumption and high computing performance.
n9e7e936e43.why: Ambiq designs low-power semiconductors for edge and battery-powered devices, so its listing is a test of investor appetite for chip IPOs.

n5f5b48b72e.headline: Stock market soars to new all-time high
n5f5b48b72e.summary: The Pakistan stock index rose past 142,000 points to an all-time high, helped by a TFC payment to OGDC and hopes for cement sector results.
n5f5b48b72e.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange in Karachi, and its moves reflect local investor sentiment and corporate earnings expectations.
n5f5b48b72e.why_moved: A TFC payment to OGDC and expectations for cement sector results lifted the index to a record.

nedd762548d.headline: Sri Lanka is clearing AliExpres, Temu goods with border taxes, no de minimis
nedd762548d.summary: Sri Lanka is charging all taxes on foreign parcels from online platforms such as AliExpress and Temu, with no de minimis exemption. Customs officials said backlogs have been cleared.
nedd762548d.why: AliExpress and Temu are cross-border e-commerce platforms, and changes to parcel duties affect their pricing and shipping volumes in importing markets.

n8c5fe387c5.headline: Toyota, Honda brace for profit falls as US tariffs, strong yen weigh
n8c5fe387c5.summary: Toyota expects a 31% drop in operating profit and Honda a 36% decline in weaker first-quarter earnings. Both cite US import tariffs and a stronger yen, despite robust hybrid demand.
n8c5fe387c5.why: Toyota and Honda are major Japanese automakers whose earnings are sensitive to US tariffs, export volumes and currency moves.

nffce3fdc70.headline: World nearly beat polio. But fake records, an imperfect vaccine and missteps aided its comeback
nffce3fdc70.summary: Penalties on rice exporters have been waived after a delegation complained about the unavailability of the Export Refinance Facility from various banks.
nffce3fdc70.why: Rice is a major agricultural export for Pakistan, and export financing conditions affect exporters' margins and trade flows.

n09ba33fa1b.headline: In the news today: Carney scheduled to visit B.C. Interior Tuesday
n09ba33fa1b.summary: Vancouver-based Ascot Resources Ltd. released its second-quarter 2025 results on August 12, 2025, trading on the TSX under the symbol AOT.
n09ba33fa1b.why: Ascot Resources is a Canadian mining company that develops and operates a gold and silver mine in British Columbia.

ne9e4b3f24f.headline: Pune real estate: K Raheja Corp subsidiary buys 7.43-acre land parcel near Pune for  ₹195 crore
ne9e4b3f24f.summary: K Raheja Corp’s subsidiary KRC Queens Pvt Ltd acquired a 7.43-acre land parcel near Pune from Mahalunge Real Estate Developers for ₹195 crore, earmarked for a township project.
ne9e4b3f24f.why: Land acquisitions by major developers signal growth in real estate development and investment activity in regional markets.

nd9612ba62d.headline: Jaguar Land Rover appoints Tata executive as new CEO
nd9612ba62d.summary: Jaguar Land Rover named the chief financial officer of Tata Motors as its new CEO, effective soon.
nd9612ba62d.why: Jaguar Land Rover is a major luxury car manufacturer owned by Tata Motors; leadership changes can influence strategic direction and performance.
